description: Turn automatic encryption (HLS) of NEW uploads on or off. No credit cost. Turning on is only for Gold/Enterprise plans or accounts with the 'Anti-Download Criptografado' add-on (checked before changing; otherwise refused). Existing videos don't change: to encrypt them use panda_encrypt_videos (paid). Turning off only affects future uploads: videos already encrypted stay encrypted, and a paid add-on stays billed until it is removed in the dashboard.

enabled.description: true = encrypt new uploads; false = stop

name: panda_set_new_uploads_encryption
title: Set New Uploads Encryption
